Subject: Post-call recap + proposed MAP (next steps)

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) based on what we discussed so we all have clear next steps.

Recap (high level):
- Use case: FinPay wants to integrate Redwood for real-time payment memo generation and fraud-reranking in the checkout flow.
- Decision criteria: latency <= 120ms p95, predictable unit costs, SOC 2 compliance, and support for private deployment (VPC) for cardholder data scope.
- Timeline: preferred pilot in July, production H2 FY25.

Proposed MAP (draft):
1) Security review (Priya) — Redwood provides SOC 2 Type II, data flow diagram, and encryption/KMS details — deliverable: security packet — owner: Redwood (Dev) — target: 2025-06-18
2) Procurement review (Tom) — commercial terms & SOW redlines — owner: FinPay (Tom) & Redwood (Aditya) — target: 2025-06-25
3) Pilot run (technical) — 2-week pilot on Dedicated pool or VPC test instance — owner: FinPay engineering + Redwood SE — target kickoff: 2025-07-07
4) Exec alignment / economic buyer sign-off — present pilot metrics and TCO — owner: FinPay execs + Redwood AE — target: 2025-07-21

Requests from us:
- Please confirm primary security and procurement contacts (we heard Priya and Tom on the call) and any additional eval criteria not listed.
- If the timeline above looks realistic, we can convert this draft into a shared MAP (Google Sheet) and track milestones weekly.

I attached a MAP template and will pull together the SOC2 cert and DFD once Dev confirms the final documents.

Next steps (today):
- Samantha: confirm contacts + priority decision criteria.
- Aditya/Dev: prepare security packet and initial commercial terms.
- I'll schedule a 30-minute MAP alignment next week (suggest Wed 6/18 10:00am PT).

Thanks — looking forward.

--
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — this is really helpful and aligned with what we discussed. Confirming contacts: Tom is our procurement lead and Priya is our security lead (copying both). Two small clarifications on decision criteria:

- Latency: 120ms p95 for the memo endpoint is the bar, but for reranking it can be up to 200ms p95. Would like to see profiles for both in the pilot.
- Data scope: Cardholder data will remain in our PCI environment; we need confirmation around KMS and audit logs if using VPC.

Tom / Priya — can you confirm the review timelines? I flagged July for a pilot but procurement may need the week of 6/23 to review initial commercial terms. Also forwarding our vendor onboarding checklist for visibility (see brief summary below).

Best,
Samantha

Hi Priya / Samantha — thanks for the notes. Quick answers and attachments:

1) SOC 2: attaching Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf (redacted cover + cert). We also have a security packet with our encryption, KMS integration (support for AWS KMS & customer-managed keys), and network segmentation for VPC deployments.
2) Audit logs: Redwood provides per-request metadata and audit logs for private deployments; retention windows are configurable per contract (we typically support 90 / 365 / custom).
3) Latency profiles: We'll run two small benchmarks during pilot (memo endpoint + reranker) and provide p50/p90/p95 numbers on your hardware profile.

I attached a draft MAP template (Redwood_MAP_Template.xlsx) — Marissa, feel free to convert to Google Sheet and share.
